title: Misty Breakwater: Naval Navigation

foundation.history: The historic sea wall was built to protect fog horns, but low-visibility tides interrupted its stewardship.

premise: Kela Kiri, a captain, must reconnect isolated trading ports using route and tide planning while low-visibility tides threatens the historic sea wall.
central_conflict: a blockade fleet seeks control of fog horns; residents want accountable access.

plot_beats.name: Arrival
plot_beats.cause: low-visibility tides isolates the historic sea wall
plot_beats.effect: Local routes and witnesses become inaccessible

plot_beats.name: The bargain
plot_beats.cause: a blockade fleet offers privileged access to fog horns
plot_beats.effect: The player must decide whether to share information

plot_beats.name: The remedy
plot_beats.cause: The production plan determines who controls the restored system
plot_beats.effect: Faction trust changes the final public arrangement

endings.consequence: Stewardship passes to a representative public council
Resident cooperatives operate the recovered infrastructure
The essential route survives with unresolved governance debts
